facts.fact: The BCEAO certifies business APIs for direct connection to the PI-SPI instant payment platform, and its list of 34 certified APIs across WAEMU, one of them Togo's Ecobank, was updated on 9 November 2026.
Togo institutions provide services on PI-SPI, the BCEAO's WAEMU-wide instant payment platform; the article does not mention PAPSS.
